description:
## Goal

At the actual lexical value use, treat a known callable whose published kind is not available yet as a typed pending prerequisite. Demand its ModuleInterface producer through the ordinary exact fact edge. A missing or invalid provider remains a terminal diagnostic, and a macro remains invalid as a runtime value.

## TDD

The selective-import example f = add; f.(1, 2) returns 3. Local shadowing and unused imports demand nothing. Nested closures use their real lexical environment. Published macros are rejected at the reference span. An earlier successful read followed by a fatal expression retains exact observations.

## Acceptance

No environment-blind prepass, retry queue, provider registry, scanner or missing-kind compatibility error remains. Unchanged success does no work; unrelated edits do no requested-root work; relevant interface movement wakes the exact lowerer once. Full semantic and target-door fidelity passes.

## Ordering

This is a lowering/demand-correctness ticket outside fz-tfn. It follows fz-kdt.46 so pending prerequisites use the final exact-edge mechanism.
title: Demand published kinds for bare imported callable values
